gaps: Phase 1 still-port: the panel renders open with its end values; ARC's `.module.css` owns the enter/exit transitions (including `@starting-style` and the `data-state="closed"` exit), so no motion-library wiring is present yet.

Transform-origin CSS variable mismatch: ARC's CSS reads `var(--radix-popover-content-transform-origin)`; bits-ui sets `var(--bits-popover-content-transform-origin)`. Inert in Phase 1 (no scale animation), but Phase 2 must alias one to the other or the scale origin falls back to centre.

ARC's popover is a compound module (Root/Trigger/Content/Close re-exports). The port ships one Svelte file per part plus an `index.ts` barrel; the Root/Trigger/Close are thin pass-throughs, and the Content keeps ARC's Portal wrap and default `align`/`sideOffset`/`collisionPadding`.
